title: [Runner] Fix false-positive Win+Shift+C shortcut conflict on Windows 11

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The actual strict parser fixtures passed with caller-observed counts of zero, one and eight, and five malformed inputs were rejected. The inert builder and qualified dependency guard also passed. A later actual runner attempt stopped after acquiring the exclusive lock because its error handler referenced an unset stage and masked the original preflight exception; no build, discovery or test ran, and the lock was released. The original exception was not recoverable from the saved output. A subsequent failure-capture fixture was inconclusive because its nested catch execution did not represent the entrypoint correctly; that attempt stopped before lock acquisition. Error preservation and a representative fixture require verification before another product-validation attempt; no pass is claimed.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
